name: @red-cup-engineering/git-services-section
description: Runs git on a shared machine through one serialized write lane, with machine-specific policy, identity, and credentials in per-machine config files. Use when people and agents share one tree and concurrent git writes would corrupt work or overload the disk.

scripts.check: sh -n scripts/git-services && node --check scripts/archive-discovery && node --check scripts/archive-worktree-map && node --check scripts/audit-git-submodule-graph.mjs && node --check scripts/register-existing-git-repository.mjs && node --check scripts/relocate-a-directory.mjs && node --check scripts/relocate-a-git-repository.mjs && node --check scripts/retire-a-git-repository-to-legacy.mjs && node --check src/collect-colony-activity.mjs && node --check src/discover-archives.mjs && node --check src/map-archive-worktrees.mjs && node --check src/settle-filesystem-receipt.mjs
scripts.test: node --test test/archive-discovery.test.mjs test/archive-worktree-map.test.mjs test/relocation-cli.test.mjs test/managed-git-policy.test.js test/settle-filesystem-receipt.test.mjs test/serialized-mutation-lane.test.mjs
